open_points.subject: FlowConstant storage before proof
open_points.text: “`value`: a StoredValue (M21)” / “constants... the port exists... and the value fits its schema” is checked during proof / “A new version is written with its constants” before that proof
open_points.question: How is a constant persisted when its destination port does not exist or its value does not fit, given that no model or module offers storage for an unvalidated, schema-less constant literal?
options: Store a raw typed literal until proof succeeds
Create a StoredValue using a schema supplied in the constant request
Move destination and fit validation into composition and refuse the version
open_points.default_guess: Store the raw literal and declared class as part of the immutable FlowConstant until proof can resolve its schema.

open_points.subject: Publishing bytes before their owning record
open_points.text: “Value bytes and file fixtures go to the content-addressed area through `capability:store.put_value_bytes`” followed by “writes their StoredValues... and the TrialCase in one `capability:store.record_change`”
open_points.question: If `put_value_bytes` succeeds but the later `record_change` fails, what happens to the already-published bytes that no StoredValue or TrialCase names?
options: Offer one atomic store operation that publishes the bytes and owning records together
open_points.default_guess: Keep the unreachable bytes, matching the explicitly stated capture-store-failure behavior, although they are never served.

open_points.subject: Kernel start failure after recovery mutations
open_points.text: “every `in_flight` attempt becomes `unknown`” and recovery writes records before the surface opens / “The surface never opens; there is no partial start.”
open_points.question: When a later startup step fails after earlier recovery steps have written records or removed files, do those completed mutations remain, or must startup roll them back?
options: Completed per-call mutations remain; ‘no partial start’ means only that the surface never opens
All startup mutations are rolled back
Only specified recovery mutations remain while cleanup removals are rolled back
open_points.default_guess: Completed mutations remain because each store call is its own transaction and trace records are immutable; ‘no partial start’ refers only to serving requests.
